title: 第17章 赤山盗，任捕头
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
陆林暗自警醒。

    这看似平常的旅途，似乎多出了变数。

    果然。

    众人乱哄哄的跑了一阵，前方再次出现两块巨石，将路途堵住。

    七八个手拿刀剑，红巾蒙面之人站在巨石上。

    为首的两人。

    一个身材魁梧，气质剽悍，满脸的大胡子，手拿一柄点钢枪。那一双眼睛，带着无尽的残忍。

    身旁站着的，身材略矮，手中拿着大刀。

    “呔！”

    大胡子吼一声，“此山是我开，此树是我栽，要想从此过，把命留下来。”

    “头儿，你说错了，是把钱留下来。”

    后面的一个盗匪说道。

    大胡子呸了一声，一口浓痰吐在众人面前，“放屁，老子钱也要，命也要。”

    手中的长枪一扫，枪尖指着孙友成。

    “先交钱，再交命，若敢不从，拖去喂狗。”

    孙友成跟大胡子身旁的男子对视一眼，赶忙扑通一下跪在地上。

    “好汉爷爷饶命啊，我们就是粗鄙村夫，身上就只有些鸡鸭肉蛋，好汉若要，请尽管拿去，还望能饶我们一条贱命。”

    “哈哈哈，你也说了是贱命，既然是贱命，要了还有何用，给爷死！”

    大胡子从巨石上跃下，长枪往前一送，直直戳进孙友成的心窝。

    “啊？你……”

    孙友成没想到大胡子竟然拿他第一个开刀。

    嘴角溢出一缕鲜血。

    “涛哥！”

    身后的孙友文大惊，一跃而下来到大胡子身前。

    “涛哥，这是我哥啊，你怎么把他杀了。”

    孙友文压低了声音。

    大胡子余涛却不以为意。

    “哈哈哈，孙友文，你以为这些村民看不出来吗，你们兄弟二人自导自演，想要劫走一千八百两春税。”

    “不过你放心，老子今天不会放走一个人，你大哥死了，才能摆脱你身上的嫌疑，你说对吧。”

    “你……”

    孙友文有心争辩。

    他心中无比后悔。

    之前通过中间人联系到赤山盗，对方对他的要求满口子的答应下来。

    没想到这才刚一照面，就把大哥杀了。

    事情超出掌控。

    余涛可是正式武者，他不可能是对手。

    “孙友文，你是孙友文？竟然为了春税银子，勾结赤山盗，想把我们全都杀了？”

    “孙友文，别杀我啊，我是孙二河，你小时候还喊过我二河叔呢，我家小孙子还等我回去呢。”

    “别叫了，你没看到那赤山盗根本不听孙友文的吗，老少爷们，不想死的，就跟我一起，跟他们拼了。”

    “拼了？”

    余涛的嘴角露出一丝冷笑。

    这些愚昧的村民，怎么知道普通人和武者之间的巨大差距。

    他抬起右手。

    身后的七八个手下瞬间精神一震，脸上露出残忍的笑容。

    余涛轻轻挥了挥手。

    “杀！”

    轻飘飘的一声令下，七八个盗匪嚎叫着冲了出去。
content_en:
Lu Lin was secretly alert.

    This seemingly ordinary journey seemed to have many variables.

    really.

    Everyone ran in confusion for a while, and two huge rocks appeared in front of them again, blocking the road.

    Seven or eight masked men with swords in their hands and red scarves stood on the boulder.

    The two leaders.

    A tall man with a fierce temperament, a full beard, and a small steel gun in his hand. Those eyes were filled with endless cruelty.

    Standing next to him was a slightly short man with a big knife in his hand.

    "Bah!"

    The bearded man roared, "I built this mountain and planted this tree. If you want to live this life, keep your life."

    "Boss, you were wrong. You were keeping the money."

    said a bandit from behind.

    The bearded man made a sound and spat a mouthful of phlegm in front of everyone, "Fart, I want both my money and my life."

    The spear in his hand was swept away, and the tip of the spear was pointed at Sun Youcheng.

    "Pay the money first, then hand over your life. If you dare not obey, you will be dragged to the dogs."

    Sun Youcheng looked at the man next to the bearded man and quickly plopped down on the ground.

    "Grandpa, hero, have mercy on us. We are just vulgar villagers. We only have chickens, ducks, and eggs. If you want it, hero, please go ahead and take it. I hope you can spare our lives."

    "Hahaha, you also said it's a cheap life. Since it's a cheap life, what's the point of taking it? You'll die!"

    The bearded man jumped down from the boulder, sent his spear forward, and pierced Sun Youcheng's heart.

    "Ah? You..."

    Sun Youcheng didn't expect that the bearded man would be the first to operate on him.

    A stream of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.

    "Brother Tao!"

    Sun Youwen behind him was shocked and jumped down to the bearded man.

    "Brother Tao, this is my brother, why did you kill him?"

    Sun Youwen lowered his voice.

    The bearded Yu Tao didn't take it seriously.

    "Hahaha, Sun Youwen, don't you think these villagers can't see that you two brothers are directing and acting on your own, and you want to rob one thousand eight hundred taels of spring tax."

    "But don't worry, I won't let anyone go today. Only when your eldest brother dies can we get rid of the suspicion on you, right?"

    "You..."

    Sun Youwen was determined to argue.

    He felt extremely regretful.

    He had previously contacted Chishan Bandit through an intermediary, and the other party fully agreed to his request.

    Unexpectedly, the eldest brother was killed as soon as they met.

    Things are out of control.

    Yu Tao is a formal warrior, he cannot be his opponent.

    "Sun Youwen, are you Sun Youwen? You actually colluded with the Chishan bandits and wanted to kill us all for spring tax money?"

    "Sun Youwen, don't kill me. I am Sun Erhe. You called me Uncle Erhe when you were a child. My little grandson is still waiting for me to come back."

    "Stop yelling. Didn't you see that the Chishan bandit didn't listen to Sun Youwen at all? Young and old men, if you don't want to die, just come with me and fight with them."

    "Fight?"

    A sneer appeared on Yu Tao's lips.

    How do these ignorant villagers know the huge gap between ordinary people and warriors?

    He raised his right hand.

    The seven or eight men behind him were instantly shocked, with cruel smiles on their faces.

    Yu Tao waved his hand gently.

    "Kill!"

    With a light command, seven or eight bandits rushed out howling.
